messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in client reconnects for streaming sessions from EU at ~11:30UTC. Console shows a bunch of short-lived sessions and duplicate resume attempts.
liam: Seen it. Root cause looks like proxy added a latency clamp when a backend pod hit CPU throttle. The clamp pushed keepalive RTTs over our idle threshold and clients closed + reconnected.
noah: Are we sure it’s the clamp and not a client-side bug? Any stack traces or logs?
sara: I pulled proxy logs — we have entries like `proxy: clamp applied path=/stream ttl=120ms to=200ms`. After clamp clients hit socket idle close within ~2s of delay bumps.
metrics-bot: Alert: streaming.reconnect.rate increased 6.2x in eu-west-1 between 11:28–11:36 UTC. Top route: /v1/streams/chat (sticky routing enabled).
maria: The weird part — console per-route counts show duplicate reconnects (count++ on both old and new route) so billing/usage is inflated. I think resume-window is too short to dedupe across route handoffs.
liam: I agree. Two quick fixes: 1) increase resume window to 8s for sticky routes, 2) add a small backoff jitter client-side. But we need to avoid increasing cost too much.
noah: +1 for resume window bump only for routes with clamp-prone proxies. We should also tag telemetry with `proxy.clamp=true` so we can filter. Right now the telemetry lacks that label.
sara: telemetry change is low-risk. I'll add a proxy header `x-proxy-clamp` and surface it in span tags. That will let us query console for affected sessions.
liam: Proposal: rollout plan — canary resume_window=8000ms for sticky routes on 10% of traffic, enable telemetry header, and add server-side dedupe by resume_id across route change for 30s.
maria: Sounds good. Also need a console UX tweak: show "reconnect-suspect" badge when `x-proxy-clamp` present to avoid manual triage.
metrics-bot: Query suggestion: `sum(rate(streaming.reconnect{region="eu-west-1",proxy_clamp="true"}[5m])) by (route)` — will help validate canary.
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: config: 
```
{
  "resume_window_ms": 8000,
  "sticky_route": true,
  "telemetry_headers": ["x-proxy-clamp"],
  "dedupe_resume_id_ttl_ms": 30000
}
```
liam: If we see reconnects go down in the canary, ramp. If billing delta > 1.5x, rollback and try client jitter option instead.
maria: I'll own post-mortem and ETA for console badge. Noah / Sara, can you pair on telemetry and proxy header today?
sara: Yes, will start the header patch now.
noah: On it — will also add test harness for route handoff dedupe.
maria: thanks. Filing a short incident note and tagging infra/sre for follow-up. :thumbsup:
